title: 7-Day Istanbul & Cairo Two-Country Escape
metaTitle: Istanbul & Cairo in 7 Days | Turkey Egypt Trip
metaDescription: Experience Istanbul and Cairo in seven days, combining Ottoman and Byzantine landmarks with the Pyramids, Egyptian treasures and historic Old Cairo.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 7-Day Turkey & Egypt Tour connects Istanbul and Cairo in a compact two-country itinerary focused on two of the region’s most historically significant cities. Begin in Istanbul with guided visits exploring its Byzantine and Ottoman heritage before flying directly to Cairo. The Egyptian section shifts the historical perspective to the ancient world, with the Pyramids of Giza forming a central part of the sightseeing program.
With only two hotel bases, the seven-day route avoids additional domestic travel and keeps the journey straightforward. Selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, professional local guides, entrance fees, airport transfers, scheduled sightseeing and the international flight from Istanbul to Cairo are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Arrival in Istanbul Airport (IST) or Sabiha Airport (SAW). Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorous Cruise and Asia Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, one of the city’s most colorful and lively markets. Continue with a scenic cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia while enjoying views of palaces, mosques, and waterfront mansions. Cross the Bosphorus Bridge to Çamlıca Hill for panoramic views over the city, then visit the elegant Beylerbeyi Palace, the former summer residence of Ottoman sultans. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Cairo by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Cairo (14:00–15:20).
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour to Pyramids, Sphinx, Memphis & Sakkara
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Grand Egyptian Museum & Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.text:

Check-out and transfer to Cairo International Airport according to your flight schedule

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 7-Day Tour of Turkey & Egypt?
faqs.a: The 7-Day Tour of Turkey & Egypt covers Istanbul in Turkey and Cairo in Egypt. This itinerary combines two of the world's most historic cities, allowing travelers to experience the rich cultural heritage of the Ottoman Empire and the ancient wonders of Egypt within a short and convenient journey. The tour runs for 6 nights and 7 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 7-Day Tour of Turkey & Egypt cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,575 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and one domestic flight. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, one domestic flight is included within the itinerary. International flights between countries and international arrival/departure flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels in Istanbul and Cairo. Daily breakfast is included, while additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are selected for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Turkey and Egypt. Your guides will provide valuable insights into the history, culture, architecture, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience the highlights of both countries within a limited timeframe. It offers an excellent introduction to two of the world's most fascinating civilizations.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historical sites, museums, archaeological attractions, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Istanbul and Cairo?
faqs.a: Highlights in Istanbul include the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace, and a Bosphorus cruise. In Cairo, travelers can visit the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, the Egyptian Museum, and experience the vibrant atmosphere of Egypt's capital city.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 7-Day Tour of Turkey & Egypt?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 7-Day Tour of Turkey & Egypt be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as Cappadocia, Luxor, Aswan, or Alexandria, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
